(build/tests/bit_game_binds_five_curves_and_rejects_changed_units.rs)

On-field Psyche zone at T1: base 1000 x (1+3/25) = 1120; one 1/50 stack -> 1000 x (1+3/25+1/50) = 1140; two stacks -> 1160. The multiplicative misreading 1.12 x 1.02 = 1.1424 (-> 1142.4) is rejected. The 0.3s ICD blocks a second stack at 200_000 us and re-arms at 400_000 us. (bit_game_on_field_psyche_bonus_and_normal_attack_icd_stacks)

Off-field ATK follows the live rule ATK_live = ATK_static + base_atk x p: p = 1/10 -> 1100; p = 1/10+1/50 = 3/25 -> 1120; p = 1/10+2/50 = 7/50 -> 1140. The 2.0s ICD grants stacks for hits landing at 100_000 and 2_202_000 us but blocks the hit at 501_000 us. (bit_game_off_field_base_atk_and_damage_stacks)

T1..T5 scaling of the on-field Psyche base: 1120/1140/1160/1180/1200 = 1000 x (1+3/25 .. 1+1/5). (bit_game_t1_through_t5_scaling)

Eleven ICD-spaced on-field hits grant only 10 stacks -> hit 11 = 1000 x (1+3/25+10/50) = 1320, not the uncapped 1340. (bit_game_off_field_stacks_cap_at_four, bit_game_on_field_stacks_cap_at_ten)

While the wearer is active, it increases Psyche DMG dealt, and dealing Psyche DMG with Basic Attacks grants an additional stacking Psyche DMG bonus up to 10 stacks with a 0.3s ICD, resetting on character switch.

known_gaps: Global release availability is unverified in the frozen catalog.
The 0.3s on-field ICD is a description literal ("Triggers at most once every 0.3s"), not a frozen curve; the code binds it as ON_FIELD_ICD_US = 300_000.
The 4-stack off-field cap and 10-stack on-field cap are description literals ("up to <lv>4</> stacks", "up to <lv>10</> stacks"), enforced as max_stacks 4/10.
Off-field damage detection while the wearer is off-field is a tested hypothesis (weapons.bit_game_v1); native off-field damage attribution is not established by the frozen tables.
name: Blow up the Crowd

passive_description.localized:
Increases the active character's ATK by <lv>{0}</> while the wearer is off-field, and increases the active character's ATK by <lv>{1}</> when the wearer deals damage, up to <lv>4</> stacks and triggering at most <lv>once</> every <lv>{2}</>s. Resets the effect when the wearer becomes the active character.
Increases Psyche DMG by <lv>{3}</> while the wearer is the active character, and increases Psyche DMG by <lv>{4}</> when dealing Psyche DMG with a Basic Attack, up to <lv>10</> stacks. Triggers at most once every <lv>0.3</>s. Resets the effect when switching characters.
passive_description.source:
装备者位于后台时，当前控制的角色攻击力提高<lv>{0}</>，且装备者每次造成伤害都会使当前控制角色攻击力提高<lv>{1}</>，最多叠加<lv>4</>层，每<lv>{2}</>秒最多叠加<lv>1</>次，当装备者被切换为当前控制角色时候，该效果消失。
当装备者为当前控制角色时，魂属性异能伤害提升<lv>{3}</>，且每次「普通攻击」造成魂属性异能伤害都会使自身魂属性异能伤害提升<lv>{4}</>，最多叠加<lv>10</>层，每<lv>0.3</>秒最多触发一次，切换角色时效果消失。

placeholder_mapping.{0}: buff_BitGame2_AtkUp1 (DataList order 1, ratio): off-field base ATK
placeholder_mapping.{1}: buff_BitGame2_AtkUp2 (DataList order 2, ratio): off-field ATK per stack
placeholder_mapping.{3}: buff_BitGame2_DamageUpPsycheBase1 (DataList order 4, ratio): on-field Psyche DMG base
placeholder_mapping.{4}: buff_BitGame2_DamageUpPsycheBase2 (DataList order 5, ratio): on-field Psyche DMG per stack

tested_hypotheses: While the wearer is off-field, the active character gains an ATK percentage buff equal to buff_BitGame2_AtkUp1 (10%..14%).
When the off-field wearer deals damage, the active character gains 1 stack of an ATK percentage buff equal to buff_BitGame2_AtkUp2 (2%..3.2%), up to 4 stacks, with a 2.0s ICD (buff_BitGame2_CD).
The off-field ATK base buff and off-field stack buffs reset immediately when the wearer becomes the active on-field character.
While the wearer is on-field, the wearer gains a Psyche DMG bonus equal to buff_BitGame2_DamageUpPsycheBase1 (12%..20%).

When the on-field wearer deals Psyche DMG with a Basic Attack (Normal / Category A), the wearer gains 1 stack of a Psyche DMG bonus equal to buff_BitGame2_DamageUpPsycheBase2 (2%..3.2%), up to 10 stacks, with a 0.3s ICD (300,000 us).
The on-field Psyche base bonus and on-field Psyche stacks reset immediately when switching characters.
Weapon is restricted to Group ONE characters (Haniel, Zero, Hotori, Jiuyuan); wearers from other groups are rejected.
